    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical relative URL of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by its id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation: the courtesy 'title' followed by a space and the
                lastName (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the lastName when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for people to read: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits in space-separated groups of three.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The REGION segment of the owner's memberId: the canonical region the id was
                built from (derived from the postcode range first, falling back to the fixed
                city-to-region table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD, else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred way to reach the owner: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR'
                when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Present only
                when a birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                owner's locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                Server-assigned member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', where REGION is the
                region derived from the owner's postcode, FY is the 2-digit fiscal year of the
                registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of
                SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName), and CHK is the Luhn check digit over the
                digits of <REGION><FY><HASH8>. Deterministic from the owner's region, fiscal year
                and identity, with no sequence number (a collision is de-duplicated with a '-<n>'
                suffix).
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household, derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256(normalizedLastName +
                '|' + postcode). Assigned to every owner, so any two owners with the same lastName
                and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: '9f2c1a...'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional courtesy title, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. When supplied it
            prefixes the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied; normalized like 'address' (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address, normalized like
            'address'. When present it is appended to 'addressLine1' with a single space to form
            the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The owner's postal address. Accepted as a flat string for backward compatibility;
            when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and this becomes the
            composed, normalized address ('addressLine1' plus a space and 'addressLine2' when
            present). Stored and returned in normalized form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner, stored in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 9
          maxLength: 16
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the
            owner's city, i.e. within the inclusive range of the city's region (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-18'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when supplied it
            is stored and returned, and the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it against the
            registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, declares this owner a member of an existing household and bypasses the
            duplicate block, permitting creation even though another owner shares the same
            lastName and postcode. Such a declared member is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
            Write-only; not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical relative URL of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by its id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation: the courtesy 'title' followed by a space and the
                lastName (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the lastName when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for people to read: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits in space-separated groups of three.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The REGION segment of the owner's memberId: the canonical region the id was
                built from (derived from the postcode range first, falling back to the fixed
                city-to-region table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD, else 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred way to reach the owner: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR'
                when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Present only
                when a birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the
                owner's locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                Server-assigned member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', where REGION is the
                region derived from the owner's postcode, FY is the 2-digit fiscal year of the
                registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of
                SHA-256(normalizedTelephone + lastName), and CHK is the Luhn check digit over the
                digits of <REGION><FY><HASH8>. Deterministic from the owner's region, fiscal year
                and identity, with no sequence number (a collision is de-duplicated with a '-<n>'
                suffix).
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable identifier shared by every owner in the same household, derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256(normalizedLastName +
                '|' + postcode). Assigned to every owner, so any two owners with the same lastName
                and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: '9f2c1a...'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the SHA-256 hex digest of
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)'. Two owners are duplicates
                only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '3b8f...c1a9'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year carried by the memberId as 'FY<YY>', where the fiscal year starts
                on 1 July and is named by the calendar year it ends in (so a date on or after
                1 July belongs to the next year's fiscal year).
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                Numeric membership score assigned at creation, starting at 0: +2 when an email is
                present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or more, and +3 when
                tenure exceeds one elapsed fiscal year (the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                Numeric membership level assigned at creation, derived from membershipPoints:
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's
                registration day at the moment this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the moment this owner was created, signalling it is
                approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at creation, another owner already shared this owner's lastName
                and postcode but had a different telephone (a soft match), otherwise false. An
                owner created as a declared household member ('sharesHousehold' true) is never
                flagged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched on lastName and postcode
                at creation. Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; a
                DELETE marks it true while retaining the record, so the owner is still returned
                by GET. Deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and
                identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

`riskFlag` is a **derived, read-only response field** — it's computed from state already produced elsewhere in the owner pipeline, so it belongs in the response mapper alongside the other derived fields (`ownerSegment`, `identityKey`, `contactPreference`, …), not as a new pipeline step.

The existing class already owns the disposable-domain blocklist and the "what is this email's domain" logic, so the "adjacent" notion belongs right next to `isDisposable`. I also extracted a private `domainOf(email)` helper and reused it from `isDisposable` (removing the duplicated `@`-parsing). "Disposable-adjacent" is defined cleanly as: the domain carries a known throwaway-mail service label (`mailinator`, `tempmail`, `guerrillamail`) as one of its dot-separated labels — catching subdomains (`x.mailinator.com`) and same-service-different-suffix (`mailinator.net`) that slip past the exact-match blocklist (exact matches are rejected at creation, so only adjacent ones can reach a stored owner).

2. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — added a small `riskFlag(owner)` default method that ORs the three conditions, and wired it via `@Mapping(... expression ...)`. It reuses existing entity state:
   - *possible duplicate* → `owner.getPossibleDuplicate()`

   - *city over soft capacity* → `owner.getCapacityWarning()` (the soft-capacity band 40–49, already computed at creation)

3. **`openapi.yml`** — added the `riskFlag` read-only boolean to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field.
